shared_geometry.assembly_axes: X forward, Y left, Z up
shared_geometry.rim_interface: C003 Keiyama source record: 4×100 PCD, Ø60 centre, ET0, Ø13.5 plain holes. The source summary reports 7×8 rim and 425 kg at 20 km/h.
shared_geometry.alternate_rim_seat: Knott D12 spherical-seat fastener geometry is a different interface. Do not combine it with Keiyama Ø13.5 plain holes in one unlabeled pattern.
shared_geometry.bearings: C009 SKF SY20TF pair interface: 20 mm bore; housing envelope 127×32×64.5 mm; shaft height 33.3 mm; nominal bolt spacing 97 mm and slots 88–106 mm. Existing checked model and recorded checks are reusable.
shared_geometry.me0907_motor: Separate motor interface: Ø22.225 mm shaft, length 44.4 mm, 3/16 in (4.7625 mm) key, per local motor research. This does not define P12 axle interfaces.
shared_geometry.pro_m: C010 output-ring attributes from sheet: Ø145 h7 pilot; 12×M5 class 10.9; G-140 O-ring 3.1×139.4. Source sheet records 4×M10 class 8.8 stationary housing mounts and torque 46 N·m (source claim).
shared_geometry.pro_l: C011 output-ring attributes from sheet: Ø182 h7 pilot; 12×M6 class 10.9; AS568-261 O-ring 3.53×171.04. Source sheet records 4×M12 class 8.8 stationary housing mounts and torque 79 N·m (source condition applies).
shared_geometry.frames: Preserve each part datum from its input sheet and record transform. The P14 ring adapters have separate gearmotor ring face and rim face datums. No joint stacks, part thicknesses, fits or load sizing were inferred here.
